items.review_rationale: Reviewed real-number Cauchy quotient as classes of rational Cauchy sequences under zero-difference equivalence with pointwise arithmetic and constant-sequence rational embedding.

references.context: Set of all rational Cauchy sequences grouped into equivalence classes.

references.phrase: embedding rational q as constant sequence
references.context: Send each rational number q to class of sequence q,q,q,... in quotient.

references.phrase: field and completeness proofs not assumed
references.disposition: The construction's well-definedness, ordered-field axioms and completeness require separate proofs.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed positivity of a Cauchy-equivalence class via eventual positive rational lower bound, with representative independence using half-margin estimate.

references.context: There exist rational delta>0 and N with all a_n at or after N bounded below by delta.
Equivalent Cauchy sequence b_n has sufficiently small difference to a_n so b_n eventually >=delta/2.
Order positivity is specified by Cauchy-class representatives and rational margin, not by termwise positivity alone.

references.phrase: eventual margin stronger than eventually positive entries
references.disposition: A sequence may be eventually positive yet tend to zero, so no fixed positive delta need exist.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed chromatic number for finite nonempty loopless simple graph as smallest admissible positive k of a proper vertex coloring; palette usage need not be surjective.

references.context: Vertex set has at least one element and finitely many vertices.

references.phrase: least positive k admitting proper coloring
references.context: Minimum of admissible palette sizes over all functions assigning distinct labels to adjacent vertices.

references.phrase: not exact number of used colors
references.disposition: Existence of a proper k-coloring does not require all k labels to appear; minimal k is the chromatic number.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed continuous-index real-valued martingale in filtration t>=0 with adaptation, integrable X_t at every time and conditional expectation identity for all s<=t, absent path-continuity assumption.

references.phrase: filtration indexed by real times t>=0
references.context: Increasing family of sigma algebras F_t indexed by the nonnegative real numbers.
Finite expectation of absolute value at every time t.

references.phrase: almost sure equality of random variables
references.context: Conditional expectation equals X_s outside a probability-zero exceptional set.
For all nonnegative real time pairs with s<=t, conditional expectation of later value given F_s equals earlier value.

references.disposition: Continuous-index timing does not imply sample paths have any continuity properties.
